dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 03, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Monday's MLB Recap: Alec Burleson Sets the Tone with Historic Night**

Alec Burleson's 3-home run performance led the St. Louis Cardinals to a 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, setting a new benchmark for power in the majors. Burleson's 18th home run of the season was just the beginning, as the Cardinals' offense exploded for 13 runs and 14 hits. In a contrasting display, Washington's Derek Hill hit a home run and drove in four runs in a losing effort against the Phillies.

On the pitching front, Ian Seymour and Michael McGreevy stood out with strong outings, with Seymour striking out nine in a 6-inning performance for the Rays, and McGreevy fanning five in 4.1 innings for the Cardinals. Logan Webb also impressed, throwing a complete-game shutout for the Giants against the Rangers.
